column1: # Motor Town engine -> Engine Simulator profile. First match wins.
# asset: ECMAScript regex (case-insensitive) on the EngineData full name.
# cue: regex on the stock engine SoundCue (only engine-specific cues; the V8
#      cue is the game's default for every engine without its own sound).
# maxrpm: low-high range of the engine's MaxRPM, the last resort.
# Only electric motors keep the stock sound.
